---
title: "Prerequisites"
---

Please install these **before Day 1**. Each takes about 5–10 minutes.

::: {.req}
### 1. R

The language we use for every analysis.

- Windows: [Download R for Windows](https://cran.r-project.org/bin/windows/base/)
- Mac: [Download R for macOS](https://cran.r-project.org/bin/macosx/) (choose the Apple silicon build for M1–M4 Macs, Intel otherwise)
:::

::: {.req}
### 2. An IDE: Positron (recommended) or RStudio

The program you type R code into. Install **one** of them, after R.

- [Download Positron](https://positron.posit.co/download.html)
- [Download RStudio Desktop](https://posit.co/download/rstudio-desktop/)
:::

::: {.req}
### 3. Posit Cloud account

A free browser-based RStudio. It is your backup if an installation fails on your laptop.

- [Sign up for Posit Cloud](https://posit.cloud/) (the free plan is enough)
:::

::: {.req}
### 4. Google Antigravity 2.0

The AI coding assistant we use in the hands-on sessions.

- [Download Google Antigravity](https://antigravity.google/download) and sign in with your Google account
:::

### Check that it works

Open Positron or RStudio and type `1 + 1` in the Console. If you see `[1] 2`, you are ready.
